Workflow.Name: Verify account address with Azure Maps (sample)
Workflow.Description: Runs when the address of a account changes: checks it with Azure Maps address search, writes the verified address back to the standard address columns, and adds a note with everything Azure Maps returned. Part of the Azure Maps sample app.
